name: Municipal mains, 5/8" water meter (US/AWWA sizing)
note: flow = 75% of the meter's maximum safe flow (20 gpm = last row of the Rain Bird meter pressure-loss table), per the Rain Bird design rule; also keep meter loss <= 10% of minimum static pressure and service-line velocity <= 1.5-2.3 m/s (https://www.rainbird.com/irrigation-design-tip-water-supply). pressure = Budapest Waterworks contractual service-point band 1.5-6 bar (https://vizmuvek.hu/files/public/altalanos-pdf/10-ASZF-NLSZSZ.pdf) - measure your own static pressure (summer daytime minimum).

name: Municipal mains, DN15 meter Q3 = 2.5 m3/h (EU/MID)
note: Q3 (permanent flow) and 0.63 bar loss at Q3 from a Diehl AQUARIUS S/P DN15 datasheet; meterLoss rows below Q3 are DERIVED (loss ~ Q^2), not published. flow = 75% of Q3 (Rain Bird 75% rule applied to Q3 - an assumption). pressure = Budapest Waterworks service-point band 1.5-6 bar (https://vizmuvek.hu/files/public/altalanos-pdf/10-ASZF-NLSZSZ.pdf).

name: Well pump with pressure tank (30/50 psi switch)
note: pressure = factory cut-in/cut-out of a common Square D Pumptrol 9013FSG2J21 switch (30/50 psi = 2.07/3.45 bar); design to the cut-in pressure. flow 50 L/min = 3 m3/h, the rated flow of a Grundfos SQ 3 class 3" borehole pump (https://pumpa.eu/en/grundfos-sq-3) - replace with your pump curve at the cut-in pressure plus well lift. Edit both values for your well.

name: Rainwater tank + submersible pump (Grundfos SBA 3-45 A class)
note: Grundfos SBA 3-45 A datasheet: rated 3 m3/h (50 L/min) at 32.6 m head (3.20 bar), max head 45 m (4.41 bar, shut-off). Pressure falls as flow rises - pressure[0] is the value at the rated flow. Integrated controller restarts below ~2.2 bar (retailer data).

name: Booster / self-priming pressure pump (Grundfos SCALA2 3-45 class)
note: Grundfos SCALA2 3-45 A sheet: rated 3 m3/h (50 L/min) at 27 m head (2.65 bar), max head 45 m (4.41 bar); max flow 4.6 m3/h (76.7 L/min, from Grundfos SCALA2 3-45 sheet 93013254). Constant-pressure setpoint is adjustable (retailers: 1.5-4 bar); max inlet pressure 6 bar when boosting mains. When drawing from a tank, subtract suction lift.
